concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-guides-paypal-commerce-ios-facebook-login]] - historical, unversioned PayPal Commerce iOS Facebook Login client-configuration snapshot for Commerce Panel App ID, plist URL/query schemes and captured transport exceptions; distinct from modular `braintree-ios` and not current SDK, Facebook-authentication, security, availability, runtime-login or payment-execution proof
warnings: Keep this route scoped to the historical PayPal Commerce iOS SDK; do not transfer its plist, URL-scheme or transport settings to the modern modular braintree-ios package without current authority.
The raw does not document Facebook token/session handling, server behavior, app review, account linking or a completed authentication flow.
The captured NSAppTransportSecurity exception domains and disabled forward-secrecy requirement are historical page content, not current security guidance or runtime evidence.
